title: CONTACT bit maps to ChatContact string with no doc
description: TypeFilter has a CONTACT constant (bit 0b001) that maps to the string 'ChatContact' in both parse() and allows(). The constant name CONTACT does not match the wire string 'ChatContact'. The doc comment on the struct (line 57) says 'bit 0 = Contact' using the old name. A contributor reading the constant name will not know it refers to the 'ChatContact' JMAP type without diffing the match arms. The constant should be renamed to CHAT_CONTACT or the doc updated to explain the mapping.
